formulas.name: formula_CateringDateAlertMessage
formulas.expression:
IF( {!field_inputEventDate} - Today() < ( CASE ( WEEKDAY(TODAY()), 1, 3, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 5, 5, 5, 6, 5, 7, 4, 3) ),
"ALERT: Your event date is less than 2 full business days from today. Your submitted ticket will be created with a status of 'Pending'. Please contact a member of the Ops Team directly to confirm that your request can be accommodated.", "")

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForDataAndSystems
fields.fieldText:
Certificate/Worksheet Merge or Photo Upload: Request new student photo uploads, worksheet, and certificate merges.

Data Maintenance: Request records to be merged/deleted or participants to be re-activated.

Report/Metrics Request: Request specific metrics, new Salesforce reports, or changes to already existing reports.

Request a Conversation: Want to talk through an idea or new Salesforce functionality? Choose this option. Please share typical times you are available and who else should be a part of the conversation.

Other - Salesforce: Have an issue that isn't already listed in this menu? Choose this option. If you're receiving an error message, please copy and paste it in the ticket description.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForOnsiteSupport
fields.fieldText:
Assistance with Conference Room Setup: Need support thinking through tech options for a meeting or need help with setup? Select this.

Assistance with Doors Security: Requesting a change to the door locking schedule for an event? Lost your fob or want to request mobile fob access? Issues with your desk phone or having printer/copier issues? Requesting to review security camera footage? This option is for you.

Assistance with Zoom, Teams: Select this option if you need help setting up a conference line or would like support exploring video conferencing capabilities in Teams.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForIT
fields.fieldText: New Hire Setup, Terminations, Employee Updates: Use for new, promoted, or terminated employees, so appropriate setup or deactivation occurs. All teams involved in employee setup/deactivation will also receive notice of your request.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForMarComm
fields.fieldText:
Business Card Order/Reorder: Need business cards? Please include the following in the Description below: Name; Title; Phone Number; Email Address; Cara, Cleanslate, Cara Connects (select one). Note: All business card orders are processed once per month.

Marketing/Print Materials Reorder: Request a reorder of flyers, posters, sell sheets, or any other marketing/print materials.

Photo Request/Social Media Opportunity: Have an event, special guest, or Cara participant milestone you’d like photographed and/or documented on social media? Let us know! Note: Subject to availability.

Request Custom Marketing Materials: Need a custom flyer, poster, sell sheet, or other marketing/print material? Let us know here.

Website Edit: Request an update to website content, including edits to copy, photos, forms, and blogs.

Brand Police/Request a Conversation: Need to discuss something related to Cara branding or potentially new marketing materials? Select this option to request a review or conversation about materials.

Other Marketing & Communications: Have an issue that isn’t already listed in this menu? Choose this option.

fields.name: text_businessCardsReorderHints
fields.fieldText: Business Card Order/Reorder: Need business cards? Please include the following in the Description below: Name; Title; Phone Number; Email Address; Cara, Cleanslate, Cara Connects (select one). Note: All business card orders are processed once per month.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForRoomSetup
fields.fieldText: Facilities Details Needed: Please fill out all fields below. Use 'Description' to let us know if you require a unique setup that does not match our published room set ups and we can work to accommodate these adjustments. All tickets must be submitted at least two working days ahead of the event. For example, if your event is on a Monday, we would need the request to be in no later than the previous Wednesday at 4:30 PM. This allows the operations team time to clarify any issues and provide you with a safe and effective room layout.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForRoomSetupCatering
fields.fieldText: Room & Catering Details Needed: Please fill out all of the fields below. Use 'Description' to let us know the type of food that should be ordered and any special instructions around drop-off logistics. Please give a week's notice for food orders.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForCatering
fields.fieldText: Catering Details Needed: Please fill out all of the fields below. Use 'Description' to let us know the type of food that should be ordered and any special instructions around drop-off logistics. All tickets must be submitted at least three working days ahead of the event. For example, if your event is on a Monday, we would need the request to be in no later than the previous Tuesday at 4:30 PM. This allows the operations team time to complete your order.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForRequestInvoice
fields.fieldText: Request an Invoice: In the ticket description, please include a link to the Org record of the customer, the event or campaign, due date of payment, expected date of payment, pledge/funded amount, and the date needed by.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForCompensateParticipant
fields.fieldText: Compensate a Participant: Compensation will almost always be via cash gift cards, in increments of $25. Please specify participant name and details in description.

fields.name: text_categoryHintsForERCEventCategories
